scope: Reporting-only integrated dataset supplement; no model fitting or reselection

tables.label: tab:roles
tables.caption: Original, V2 and V3 role counts: scans / harvest populations. Final O is the original final-fit partition, not the V4 refit.

tables.label: tab:original
tables.caption: All original later-season scored operating points, reproduced from the frozen metrics.

tables.label: tab:delta
tables.caption: Complete descriptive delta sensitivity: conditional missed rates and bank-loss rates for unchanged policies.

tables.label: tab:season5groups
tables.caption: Season-5 primary-bank results by each of its two harvest populations; no population-bootstrap intervals are assigned.

tables.label: tab:action
tables.caption: All saved action-head diagnostics (B: proposed bank-reference controller; R: rich-reference controller).

tables.label: tab:v2predictors
tables.caption: All held-season V2 predictor errors and all common-order fixed-length controls. Hybrid at depth 8 equals PLS.

tables.label: tab:endpoint
tables.caption: All V2 endpoint decompositions: mean signed absolute-error reduction [95\% population-bootstrap interval].

tables.label: tab:v2adaptive
tables.caption: All 144 V2 stopping operating points. Cal/Held denote engineering feasibility/success only; scientific rows have no such pass label.

tables.label: tab:v2paired
tables.caption: All 192 V2 paired comparisons; no bank, predictor, seed or registered contrast is omitted.

tables.label: tab:designcomposition
tables.caption: V3 design-set composition, identical for P/U and both predictor families. Held-season-1 design is dominated by season 3.

tables.label: tab:orders
tables.caption: Every V3 selected nested order (nm) and design score. Score is the summed design MSE over depths 2--7; margin is second-best minus best.

tables.label: tab:subsets
tables.caption: All 84 independently selected V3 fixed subsets, including depths 2--8. Design RMSEP is a selection statistic, not held-season accuracy.

tables.label: tab:v3fixed
tables.caption: Every V3 fixed-length operating point: 252 RMSEP values. Catalog/Designed are nested prefixes; Subset is the independently selected mask at each depth.

tables.label: tab:v3adaptive
tables.caption: Every V3 adaptive operating point on catalog and designed orders. Scientific points have no engineering pass label.

tables.label: tab:v3paired
tables.caption: All 96 V3 paired contrasts with sampled-population intervals and achieved budget comparability.

tables.label: tab:stability
tables.caption: Complete pairwise Jaccard overlap of V3 selected channel sets across outer design splits (168 values). This describes stability, not accuracy.

tables.label: tab:candidateselection
tables.caption: All V4 finalization scores: development LOPO tuning results only. These are not independent validation accuracy.
